skills.desc: A basic attack, taught to all adventurers. Damage dealt is based on your weapon damage.
A powerful strike. Applies Armor Shred to your target, reducing their Damage Resistance by 10% for 5 seconds.
A powerful and precise blow which stuns your target for 3 seconds.
Empower your weapon, causing your next two Auto Attacks to be unavoidable critical hits. If On Guard was active at the time of application, the Auto Attacks will deal double damage.
Take a defensive stance. Applies On Guard, increasing your Damage Resistance by 50% for 5 seconds.
Equip a potion or scroll from your inventory to use it here.

A powerful strike, dealing 190% weapon damage.
A precise blow which stuns your opponent for 4 seconds.
Your next two auto attacks taken within 5 seconds will be powerful critical hits which cannot be avoided.
Challenge your opponent, dealing damage while reducing your incoming damage by 50% for 10 seconds.
